items.reason: Tests pin .from/.upToNextMajor/.upToNextMinor coming back as a lower-inclusive upper-exclusive .range; inclusive-upper/exclusive-lower/unbounded ranges now throw EncodingError instead of being normalised (tested).

Chose 'share the strict decoder': Package.Manifest now decodes dependencies through Package.Manifest.Evaluation._DependencyWire + Package.Dependency.Evaluation.init (exactly one discriminator, exactly one record, non-empty identity/path) and converts; toDependency() removed. A local sourceControl location has no Package.Dependency.Source case, so it throws a DecodingError naming that and pointing to Package.Manifest.Evaluation (which keeps it) rather than keyNotFound 'remote'. Representing local in Package.Dependency would be a public enum change — left for the owner.

api_changes: No public signature changes. Behaviour: Package.Manifest.encode throws EncodingError for unbounded / exclusive-lower / inclusive-upper ranges; Package.Manifest.init(from:) rejects ambiguous or multi-record dependency entries and empty identity/path, as Package.Manifest.Evaluation already did
notes: No package under repos/ outside this one encodes or decodes Package.Manifest via JSON (grep for Package.Manifest.self found none); swift-compositions/swift-package-manager imports SPM Standard but uses no changed internal API.
